cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Leave your desk and stand by that open window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I need to know whether my team follows a direct request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing. Can I get my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then come back and hold it while I check the rest of the team.

mechanism: A presents escalating cold-window and coat-fetching burdens as a pupil test of accepting its requests.
confusable: Not a practical workplace instruction: B need for warmth becomes another authority test.
comparison: Empty-box repetition versus personal discomfort and extra service.
